externalBlockers.resource: A dedicated isolated execution worker — a separate Fly.io application or machine pool that can run a container runtime, distinct from the xroga-api app.
externalBlockers.purpose: Section 7 requires generated code to execute in a disposable, network-denied, unprivileged sandbox. The API host has no nested container runtime, so DockerSandboxRuntime.probe() always fails in production and every executable validation refuses.
externalBlockers.consequence: Command 1 cannot be reported as command_1_verified while this remains open.
